_doc: Read by scripts/governance/sweep-enabled-units.py. For units whose real output is not a file mtime under a declared path. journal_marker: regex that the unit's journal must match within 3x its timer interval (proof the run did work, not just exited 0). conditional_paths: {path: ENV_NAME}; the path is only written when ENV_NAME is non-zero in the unit environment.

ai-mcp-process-watch.service.why: Writes alert JSONL only when an unexpected executable is found; each run logs 'Checked N services, N PIDs, N alerts' to the journal. An untouched log dir means no alerts, not a dead job.

ai-autonomous-improvement.service.why: Inserts metrics into Postgres and logs the count to the journal; it writes no files under DATA_DIR on a healthy cycle. AQ_WORKFLOW_DEVIATION_LOG_PATH is an input written by the deviation broker, not by this unit.

ai-switchboard.service.why: Budget state is only persisted when SWB_REMOTE_DAILY_TOKEN_CAP > 0 (switchboard.py near line 3688); with no cap there is nothing to persist.
